categories.main_business_segments: Donglai Coating Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-performance coatings based on advanced petrochemical new materials. Its main business segments include automotive aftermarket repair coatings, new car interior and exterior coatings, new car body coatings, and coatings for the 3C consumer electronics field. The company also provides professional on-site color matching services and technical support related to these coatings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D in polymer materials, continuous optimization of coating formulations, manufacturing process accumulation, and digital color matching technologies. It has developed multiple patented technologies in waterborne coatings, fast-drying automotive repair coatings, UV-curable coatings, and environmentally friendly formulations. Production processes involve physical mixing, high-speed dispersion, grinding, inspection, and packaging, with a focus on waterborne and environmentally friendly coatings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive OEMs and authorized 4S dealerships, covering mainstream domestic and international car brands such as BMW, BYD, Toyota, Volkswagen, and others. The company serves automotive OEMs for new car coatings and the automotive aftermarket for repair coatings. It also serves the 3C consumer electronics industry, providing coatings for products like smartphones, laptops, and smart home devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong presence in key regions including Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and other major cities. It has begun expanding overseas, notably establishing a wholly-owned subsidiary in North America. Overseas sales account for approximately 13% of total revenue, with exports including automotive body coatings.
categories.supply_chain_position: Donglai Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive and electronics coatings supply chain, focusing on the production and supply of coatings and related technical services to OEMs and aftermarket service providers. It collaborates closely with upstream chemical raw material suppliers for R&D and downstream automotive manufacturers and repair service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with sustained R&D investment focused on high-performance, environmentally friendly waterborne coatings, digital color matching, and compact coating processes. Strategic initiatives include expanding waterborne coating production capacity, developing coatings for new energy vehicles, and enhancing global market penetration. It also emphasizes digital transformation and service-oriented manufacturing to deepen customer engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of coating products to automotive OEMs, authorized dealerships, and 3C electronics manufacturers. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by authorized distributors in certain regions. It also provides value-added technical services such as on-site color matching and spray painting guidance, which are bundled with product sales without separate charges.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Donglai Technology is the leading Chinese brand in the automotive coatings sector, competing against major international players such as PPG, BASF, Axalta, and AkzoNobel. It holds unique certifications and supplier qualifications from many mainstream automotive OEMs, positioning itself as a high-end, innovative domestic alternative with strong technical and service capabilities. The company is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 597.5 million, representing a 15.14% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 84.7 million, up 64% from the previous year. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of RMB 1.59 billion and continues to invest in R&D, with expenditures accounting for over 5% of revenue. It has a positive cash flow from operations and actively returns value to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Donglai Technology differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive OEM certifications, and a robust service network including digital color matching systems and professional on-site support. Its focus on environmentally friendly waterborne coatings and customized color solutions meets evolving market demands, especially in new energy vehicles and high-end automotive segments. The company’s integrated product and service model enhances customer loyalty and operational efficiency, establishing it as a trusted partner in the automotive coatings industry.
